sd_design_context.isolation: Two TI TMUX1511PW, powered by SD_3V3 after R405, with six used SEL pins driven by independent SD_IO_EN=IOX P13, with R223 changed to10k for worst-case sixSEL input leakage. Two unused SEL pins tied GND; unused S/D pins explicitlyNC.
sd_design_context.sequence: Default isolate; SD_EN high, wait qualified rail-settle interval, then SD_IO_EN high. Shutdown: reject requests, flush/close/unmount, stop SDMMC, SD_IO_EN low, then SD_EN low. Power-off does not repair unsafe storage shutdown.
sd_design_context.pullups: Five10k1% pulls on card-side CMD/DAT0-3 to SD_3V3. Clock100k to GND. All remain card-side of isolation.
sd_design_context.signal_integrity: MCU-side source tuning links: CLK22ohm initially, CMD/DAT0-3 zero-ohm initially. Begin initialization400kHz;20MHz4-bit is a validation target, not a guarantee. No1.8V UHS.
sd_design_context.detect: J7019->SD_DETECT_CONTACT->R708100ohm->SD_CD_N;J70110GND. Existing R216100kAON pull-up; C70410nF on SD_CD_N, nominal1ms. Poll/debounceIOX; removal is not transactional storage safety.
sd_design_context.power: C70210u plus C703100n at socket, C701/C705100n at both TMUX; add to existing C40622u downstream of R405. #FLG701 assumes R405 fitted. Include actual card peak current versus socket0.5A rating.
sd_design_context.esd: FourTI TPD2E2U06DCKR devices cover six bus lines, detect contact and cardVDD. Each IO pair is clamped to GND without a supply clamp rail. Connector-side placement and board ESD verification required.
sd_design_context.mechanical: Candidate standardKiCad footprint Connector_Card:microSD_HC_Hirose_DM3AT-SF-PEJM5. Eight functional pins verified; mapping of nonpolar detect pair toKiCad9/10 documented. ExactA/Bphysical positions, clearance, keepout, ejection and assembly must be reviewed with the real part before release.
sd_design_context.default_control: Root R223 is10k: six SEL input leakage maximum2uA each gives0.12V worst-case before IOX leakage. When enabled,3.3V/10k adds330uA to active consumption; LOW/off does not add that pull-down current to soft-off budget.
sd_design_context.ramp_boundary: TMUX1511 S/D absolute maximum is6V independent ofVDD. Recommended signal limit ismin(2VDD,5.5V) forVDD>=1.5V and3.6V forVDD<1.5V. The narrow intermediate region may exceed recommended signal range; validate transition behavior and leakage, without claiming a board-qualified power sequencing guarantee.
